questions.questionText: In the word JOURNEY, how many pairs of letters have as many letters between them in the word as there are between them in the English alphabet? (Count the pair in either order.)

questions.questionText: If the English alphabet is written in reverse order (Z to A), which letter is the 4th to the left of the 20th letter from the right end?
questions.explanation: The 20th letter from the right is at position 7 from the left; 4 places to the left gives position 3, which in Z..A is X.
questions.shortcut: Reverse the alphabet mentally: Z=1, Y=2, X=3 ... ; then count.

questions.questionText: If the English alphabet is written in reverse order (Z to A), which letter is the 8th to the right of the 7th letter from the left?

questions.shortcut: Reverse the alphabet mentally: Z=1, Y=2, X=3 ... ; then count.
